rows.notes: Released mission title reused verbatim from missions_019.json.

rows.en: <operator(30090,1)><speed(2)><color(5)>Saotome<ce()> is bound to be there too. We'd like to open the attack right away, but there's one problem.

<operator(30090,1)><speed(2)><thumbnail(253)>The place where the <book(48)>Shin Dragon<endbook()> is sits in <book(38)>New Federation<endbook()> territory, with <book(38)>New Federation<endbook()> forces deployed there.
rows.notes: thumbnail(253) kept at the head of the sentence, same position as the source (a lead-in establishing shot, not attached to one word).

rows.en: <operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>Not only the units stationed there - it looks like a good number of reinforcements are coming in too.
rows.notes: Speaker 30060 = Jamil Neate. 'Not only' used instead of 'not just' to avoid the lowercase j.

rows.en: <operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>Throwing in a force this large means the <book(48)>Shin Dragon<endbook()><thumbnail(254)> isn't their only target.
<operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>It means the <book(38)>New Federation<endbook()> is getting serious about crushing us.
<operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>Behind the scenes, <color(5)>Berkt<ce()><thumbnail(189)> is probably the one pulling the strings. But we can't let him keep having his way any longer.
rows.notes: Berkt is male per character_names_021/glossary.json; 'he/him' sourced.

rows.en: <operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>First we should hold back the <book(38)>New Federation<endbook()> here and stop the <book(51)>Getter Rays<endbook()> from falling into <color(5)>Berkt<ce()>'s hands.
<thumbdown()><operator(30090,1)><speed(2)>Either way, both are enemies we have to defeat. I'm counting on you.
